collection.title: Mercedes-Benz E Class Estate 2003 to 2009 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Mercedes-Benz E Class Estate 2003 to 2009 (W211) will fit, this model requires a 26" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this E Class which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
